en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide landscape view from a forested hillside or cliff down over mixed woodland, fields and a distant lake. The foreground is densely covered with trees on a steep slope at the right, with flatter farmland and additional forest stretching to the horizon and water in the background. At the bottom are printed captions indicating the location and publisher/photographer details.
